questions.stem_text:
The aggregate demand curve has a negative slope in part because when the price level
increases

options.A: the real quantity of money increases

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the real quantity of money increases

questions.stem_text: The characteristic roots of the MA process $y_t = -3 u_{t-1} + u_{t-2} + u_t$ are

What school of economists defended Say's Law? Which pro-minent economist disputed this
theory?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Chicago school, Stiglitz

questions.stem_text:
An increase in the price level and a decrease in real GDP in the short run could be the
result of

options.A: a decrease in the money supply.
options.C: a sudden surge in technological innovation.
options.D: a prolonged period of very bad weather.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - a prolonged period of very bad weather.

questions.stem_text: If a series, y, follows a random walk, what is the optimal one-step ahead forecast of y?

options.B: The median value of y over the in-sample period
options.C: The minimum value of y over the in-sample period
options.D: The value of y two periods back

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The current value of y
